coverage.dem_name: LOLA 5 m/px LDEM — Site20v2 (Mons Mouton / Leibnitz beta plateau) + LOLA 20 m/px polar LDEM (LDEM_80S_20M, PDS LOLA GDR v2.0) + LOLA 40 m/px polar LDEM (LDEM_80S_40M, PDS LOLA GDR v2.0)

warnings: Sample data — saved example: real LOLA terrain, but SYNTHETIC Sun/Earth positions (development stub; the real JPL Horizons ephemeris is not integrated yet).
SYNTHETIC EPHEMERIS (development stub): Sun and Earth positions are NOT real. Do not use these results.
Horizon is modeled out to 101 km from the target: LOLA 5 m/px tile nearby, LOLA 20 m and 40 m/px polar DEM beyond it. Terrain farther than 100 km is not modeled.
Large ellipse: sampled every 71 m (384 of 755 grid nodes).
Survival probability assumes the landing point is uniformly distributed inside the ellipse.
sources: JPL Horizons System (Solar System Dynamics Group, NASA JPL) — Sun and Earth topocentric positions
LRO LOLA 5 m/px LDEM — Site20v2 (Mons Mouton / Leibnitz beta plateau) (Barker et al. 2021, NASA GSFC PGDA)
LRO LOLA 20 m/px and 40 m/px south polar LDEM (LRO-L-LOLA-4-GDR-V1.0, product v2.0, NASA PDS Geosciences Node; Smith et al. 2017)
